# The extension guide

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/guide.mjs` from packages/contracts/extension-api.json and packages/contracts/hub-slots.json; edit those, or the script's text, never this file. The lint lane's `node scripts/guide.mjs --check` fails when it drifts from them. -->

A package is a folder: `deepbuild.json`, its manifest in the one package envelope (an `owner/name` ID, a version, the digest of its files and, when signed, its publisher's key and signature), and its code: `index.ts` for TypeScript, or an executable `main` that speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdio in any language. Every package outside DeepBuild's signed release runs sandboxed, out of process, whoever wrote it. Each method below is marked with the release it arrives in; a preview method can still change before a shipped piece of its release calls it.

The installer refuses a package whose digest isn't its files', whose signature doesn't verify, or whose key isn't the one trusted for it; one that replaces a piece of the trusted ring (`app-shell`, `canvas-core`, `supervisor`, `installer`) or the done gate; one that conflicts with an installed package (`conflicts`); one that registers a check kind an installed package holds without declaring it `replaces` it; and one that runs on a kernel contract version (`kernel`) the kernel doesn't publish.

## Two worked examples

The same check twice, `ext.<plugin>.relative`: it passes when every input a check names is a path inside the checkout, and fails naming each one that isn't. Each folder's `example.json` lists the runs it answers.

- [`extension-guide/typescript`](extension-guide/typescript/): `index.ts`, calling `deep.registerCheck` in-process style through the `deep` object the host hands it.
- [`extension-guide/json-rpc`](extension-guide/json-rpc/): `main`, a Python program that answers the host's `load` by calling `deep.registerCheck` over JSON-RPC, then answers each `run`.

To build one, copy the folder, write `packageDigest` of it into `deepbuild.json`'s `digest`, and point a `main`'s `#!/usr/bin/env` line at its interpreter. Then install it, run its conformance, load it, and run its check.

## A first plug-in

Most plug-ins need few methods. Start with these 13, in this order.

### `deep.on`

In R1 · preview · `d1:a835ee7b3bd031e52a8ce58545b0b68d8a45a4b388fc8943bca15c65a9cba077`

Handles an event: session.start, tool.before, tool.after, prompt.submit, agent.stop, pr.opened, merged, released or schedule. A handler adds context for the agent or denies with a reason; outside DeepBuild's signed release, both only fill templates the manifest declares, with typed values.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | string | yes |

### `deep.registerView`

In R1 · preview · `d1:13a87be727b3bee24e988056df0a299ae55bc59ff858ea6e9bb1ff9e09aaeb98`

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |
| `panel` | string | yes |
| `area` | `sidebar` · `home` · `tab` · `line` | yes |

## The rest of the API

### `deep.registerCheck`

In R1 · stable · `d1:ef964cca49b77fd02010af414d06151d4e00e842b9714db30b16a99a920e797c`

A check kind: its runner gets a spec and the checkout and returns the run's outcome, the tests it ran, each failure from the tool's own report and the evidence. The verdict is the core's, never the runner's.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string, `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |

### `deep.registerResolver`

In R1 · preview · `d1:d746974fa9afd5e951f76f9af38954b0ad7f436f2120dc974da65e5ee39f856f`

Answers an ask with an option and the decision that covers it. The core applies the answer only when that decision is active and of the ask's kind and scope; otherwise the ask reaches you.

In R1 · preview · `d1:1e34ef8a97474d44b1cbff77e9b435e5e6b18ac4123956b0d29066f1a990dd5a`

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$` | yes |

### `deep.lease`

In R1 · preview · `d1:72f80c99488b577be1da72993587eced73bc5fe76185dec9159ede0ac6513665`

Leases a resource of a declared lease.kind@1 kind, the core's or one a manifest declares, exclusive or shared, held by the package itself: the grant, or the refusal naming the holder.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `resource` | object | yes |
| `mode` | `exclusive` · `shared` | yes |

In R1 · preview · `d1:9a22da7084c9353b5a2acb7912aee3fbac5c471d4d6d6d2b6f5977a56a0362d4`

## Slots

Each kind of thing a package registers fills a slot: its interface with a frozen digest, how many pieces may fill it, its kit in the conformance package and the planted wrong fills that kit must fail. A second fill of a slot that takes one is refused at install unless its manifest says it replaces the first.

| Method | Variant | Interface | Fills | Kit | Planted wrong fills | Since |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deep.registerCheck` | - | `check.kind@1` | one per kind | `check.kind@1` | `crashed-suite`, `past-deadline`, `dropped-output`, `type-error-as-assertion` | R1 |
| `deep.registerResolver` | - | `resolver@1` | many | `resolver@1` | `unnamed-decision`, `names-revoked`, `names-other-kind`, `names-other-repo` | R1 |
| `deep.registerSource` | `stream` | `source@1` | many | `source@1` | `skips-first-after-resume` | R1 |
| `deep.registerSource` | `polled` | `reading.source@1` | many | `reading.source@1` | `cache-as-of` | R2 |
| `deep.registerSource` | `mcp` | `reading.source@1` | many | `reading.source@1` | `stale-mcp-digest` | R2 |
| `deep.registerEnvironment` | - | `environment@1` | one | `environment@1` | `ready-before-health`, `unleased-port`, `leaves-grandchild`, `starts-in-worktree` | R1 |
| `deep.registerView` | - | `panel@1` | many | `panel@1` | `reaches-network`, `runs-a-program`, `moves-focus-unasked`, `draws-outside`, `covers-the-card` | R1 |
| `deep.registerAdapter` | - | `adapter@1` | one per agent | `adapter@1` | `duplicate-event-id`, `event-after-stop`, `answer-to-other-session`, `steer-outlives-interrupt`, `acknowledged-without-sign` | R1 |
| `deep.registerRoute` | - | `route@1` | many | `route@1` | `no-status`, `answers-any-method`, `get-changes-state` | R1 |
| `deep.registerIndex` | - | `index@1` | one | `index@1` | `keeps-dropped-source`, `sourceless-hit`, `stale-after-upsert`, `rebuild-is-a-no-op` | R1 |
| `deep.registerAction` | - | `action@1` | many | `action@1` | `declares-write`, `input-not-a-schema`, `output-not-json` | R2 |
